column3: With respect to the Kirby Industrial Mortgage Loan (9.3%), if any one or more of the Kirby TIC Borrowers desire to offer for sale or solicits or considers acceptance of any offer to buy such Kirby TIC Borrower’s undivided interest in the Mortgaged Property (or any part thereof), such Kirby TIC Borrower must first offer to sell such interest (or portion thereof) by delivering a written notice to the non-selling Kirby TIC Borrowers detailing the terms and conditions and at a price equal to the selling Kirby TIC Borrower’s determination of the fair market value of the interest (or portion thereof) in the Mortgaged Property. The non-selling Kirby TIC Borrowers have thirty (30) days from the receipt of such notice to either accept or reject the offer. If none of the non-selling Kirby TIC Borrowers accept the offer, the selling Kirby TIC Borrower must consummate the sale (i) within ninety (90) days of delivery of the offer notice and (ii) at or greater than the price set forth in the offer. If such conditions are not satisfied, the selling Kirby TIC Borrower’s right to sell such interest (or portion thereof) in the Mortgaged Property shall cease and the selling Kirby TIC Borrower must re-offer to sell such interest (or portion thereof) in the Mortgaged Property to the non-selling Kirby TIC Borrowers. Pursuant to the Kirby Industrial Mortgage Loan documents, the purchase option is subordinate to the lien of the mortgage and each Kirby TIC Borrower assigned its rights in the purchase option to lender. In addition, any new Kirby TIC Borrower is subject to the prior written approval of lender, in its sole discretion.
